note: Provenance for the SAM execution-receipt pack (dispatch lane SAM-EXECUTION-RECEIPT0, DRAFT, AUTHORITY_MOVEMENT=0). This pack profiles a PORTABLE EXECUTION RECEIPT for one remote MCP tool invocation carried over SAM, the first transport adapter this shape is proven for. It does not invent a new receipt family: it extends the existing canonical, closed-enum sdk_enforcement receipt_type with a new GARP body_kind (sam_execution_receipt) carried under extensions.garp.body, following the same explicit-file-input, deterministic-adapter, portable-standalone-verifier shape already proven by packs/mcp-audit-trail/v0.1/ and packs/bedrock-openai-audit/v0.1/. All artifacts here are authored in this repository: public-safe, SYNTHETIC SAM execution-observation inputs and the SRS envelope receipts deterministically built from them. They are not copied from any private corpus or external repository, and no live SAM/DAGR-MCP transport was run to produce them.

not_a_live_integration.note: A repo-wide search (this repo and every sibling GARP/ARCS/DAGR repo present on disk at authoring time) found no live 'SAM' transport implementation. Every input file in this pack is an explicit, public-safe, SYNTHETIC projection of what such a transport's observations would contain; transport_adapter.source_revision is carried as the literal fixture-declared value 'unavailable' rather than pinned to any real commit, because no real commit exists to pin to. This is the same explicit-file-only discipline already established by packs/mcp-audit-trail/v0.1/ and packs/bedrock-openai-audit/v0.1/, not a shortfall specific to this pack.

standalone_verifier_arc.claim: A prospect can run the verifier offline from receipt bytes, the explicit SAM observation input bytes, this single stdlib-only script, and the schema assets already in this repo: no garp-local checkout, no install, no network, no credentials, no env vars, no API calls, no scanner, no service access, no live SAM/DAGR-MCP process.

non_divergence.guard: tools/test_verify_standalone.py runs both the standalone verifier and the canonical validator over every fixture in this pack and fails if their envelope verdicts disagree; there is no second divergent envelope verifier.
non_divergence.note: Envelope-validation logic is vendored into the single portable artifact; the SAM-specific standing-injection guardrail is additional, pack-local logic layered on top -- it does not modify or replace the canonical checks.

standalone_verifier_arc.boundary_type_routing: The standalone verifier does NOT route on boundary_type; route authority is receipt_type/body_kind/execution_outcome/schema invariants.
